attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: 💡Use the tilemap editor to see which row the car sprite should be placed on, so it begins the project on top of a road tile.
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How can you find the coordinates of a tile? 


Solution: 

💡The row parameter in the [place sprite on top of] block should be changed to from 4 to 6.
steps.instructions:
When you move the car sprite, it drives across buildings instead of the road.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the car sprite begins the project on top of a road tile.

subgroups.title: Debugging 2D Tilemap Designs
subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that each sprite is placed in the correct location and something happens on overlap with the car sprite.

validationItems.text: Change row parameter in [place sprite on top of] block to 6.
validationItems.failureText: Update the row parameter in the [place sprite on top of] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓What tile should be selected in the (array of all tile locations) block in the [for element] loop?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which tiles should the mushroom sprites be placed on?

❓ Which block determines where the mushroom sprites are placed on the tilemap?


Solution: 

💡 The pink spawn tile should be selected in the (array of all tile locations) block.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the mushroom sprites are not placed correctly on the tilemap.


Fix the bugs in the code so that a mushroom sprite is placed on a pink spawn tile on the tilemap.

validationItems.failureText: Check the tile selected in the (array of all tile locations) block.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: 💡Tiles set as walls will not overlap with sprites! Erase walls for tiles that a sprite needs to overlap to make something happen.
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What types of tiles are sprites able to overlap? What types of tiles are sprites unable to overlap?


Solution: 

💡 The walls on the finish line tiles should be erased in the tilemap editor.
steps.instructions:
When the car sprite reaches the finish line, nothing happens!


Fix the bugs in the code so that a sound is played and the game ends in a win, once the car sprite overlaps the finish line tiles.

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Green Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about 2D platformer games and physics. In 2D platformers, we see the game as if looking from the side. We can use physics concepts, like velocity and acceleration, to make our sprites jump up onto platforms and avoid obstacles. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: Let’s Get Physics-cal!
badges.description: Use physics to control sprite movement in a platformer-style tilemap project.

badges.title: Hop, Skip, and a Jump
badges.description: Set a sprite’s y-velocity (vy).

badges.title: Defying Gravity
badges.description: Set a sprite’s y-acceleration (ay).

badges.title: Wallflower
badges.description: Check if a sprite is touching a tilemap wall before making something happen in a project.
